dense.generation: C program generates two reproducible matrices A and B. Values are pseudo-random multiples of 0.001 between -1.000 and 1.000.

sparse.generation: C program generates A with a requested percentage of zeros and nonzero candidate values drawn from multiples of 0.001 between -1.000 and 1.000. Matrix B is generated pseudo-randomly. The sparse program uses its own PRNG.
